en: Typhoon Haiyan, one of the strongest tropical cyclones ever recorded, had maximum sustained winds of 315 kilometers per hour.
The highest officially recorded air temperature on Earth was 56.7 degrees Celsius in Death Valley, California, in 1913.
Soil particles vary in size, with clay particles being smaller than 0.002 millimeters and sand particles reaching up to 2.0 millimeters.
On the Mohs hardness scale, talc is the softest mineral at level 1, while diamond is the hardest at level 10.
The Sun evaporates approximately 1.3 trillion tons of water from the Earth's surface every single day.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to travel the 150 million kilometers from the Sun to the Earth.
Our Sun contains 99.86 percent of the total mass of the entire solar system, making it vastly larger than all planets combined.
The Moon is gradually drifting away from the Earth at a rate of approximately 3.8 centimeters per year.
A magnitude 8.0 earthquake releases approximately 32 times more energy than a magnitude 7.0 earthquake.
The 1991 eruption of Mount Pinatubo ejected roughly 10 cubic kilometers of volcanic ash and rock into the atmosphere.
Jupiter, the largest planet in our solar system, has a mass that is more than 300 times greater than Earth's mass.
The Moon's diameter is 3,474 kilometers, which is roughly one-quarter the size of the Earth's diameter.
